concerns: The proposed contrast is weakened because both forms are understandable and used in both varieties.
response.cue_rationale: Both forms can mean written information describing a product.
material_concerns: Both “deskripsi produk” and “keterangan produk” can occur in Indonesian and Malaysian Malay, so the national preference may mislead learners.

preference_risk.rationale: The proposed Indonesian form is plausibly ordinary in Malaysian Malay as well, weakening the national preference.

response.rationale: The cue and sense align, but the pair does not establish a reliably distinct Indonesian–Malaysian everyday preference.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Deskripsi produk” is also used in Malaysian Malay, while “keterangan produk” is understandable and used in Indonesian; ordinary usage can therefore defeat the claimed contrast.
